metadata.question: Does location (33.97811334086217, -118.2436826460509) at Los Angeles have a higher average nitrogen dioxide concentration than location (32.7358717958782,-117.15380986802357) San Diego from 2018 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2 (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) for nitrogen dioxide concentration - Date range: 2018-01-01 to 2019-12-31 - Two point locations: Los Angeles (33.97811334086217, -118.2436826460509) and San Diego (32.7358717958782, -117.15380986802357) 2. Masking strategy: - Use qa_value >= 0.75 for quality filtering (recommended for Sentinel-5P) - The question is about NO2 concentration, not clouds, so we should mask poor quality data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid zero would be a legitimate NO2 measurement of 0 (unlikely but possible) - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if pixel counts are 0 after masking (C2) - Check if mean values are None/NaN (C3) - Compare LA vs SD: if LA > SD, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const la_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2436826460509, 33.97811334086217]); const sd_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.15380986802357, 32.7358717958782]); const start_date = '2018-01-01'; const end_date = '2019-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition const no2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('NO2_column_number_density') .filterDate(start_date, end_date); const la_col = no2_col.filterBounds(la_point); const sd_col = no2_col.filterBounds(sd_point); const la_size = la_col.size().getInfo(); const sd_size = sd_col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`LA images: ${la_size}, SD images: ${sd_size}`); if (la_size === 0 || sd_size === 0) { console.log('No data for one or both locations.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Quality Masking Function function maskNO2(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return image.updateMask(mask); } const la_masked = la_col.map(maskNO2); const sd_masked = sd_col.map(maskNO2); // 4. Calculate mean NO2 const la_mean_img = la_masked.mean(); const sd_mean_img = sd_masked.mean(); // Check pixel counts const la_count = la_mean_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: la_point.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const sd_count = sd_mean_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sd_point.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`LA valid pixels: ${la_count}, SD valid pixels: ${sd_count}`); if (la_count === 0 || sd_count === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Get mean values const la_no2 = la_mean_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: la_point.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const sd_no2 = sd_mean_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: sd_point.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`LA NO2: ${la_no2}, SD NO2: ${sd_no2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (la_no2 === null || sd_no2 === null || isNaN(la_no2) || isNaN(sd_no2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`LA avg NO2: ${la_no2.toExponential(3)}, SD avg NO2: ${sd_no2.toExponential(3)}`); if (la_no2 > sd_no2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
